title: Radial fundamental theorem of calculus for forms
statement: Let P, n, m ∈ ℕ. Let φ : ℝ^P → Λ^n(ℝ^P) (DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) be C^∞, i.e. ContDiff ℝ of order ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞). Let x ∈ ℝ^P and u ∈ (ℝ^P)^n (u : Fin n → ℝ^P). Then ∫_0^1 ( t^{m+1}·(Dφ(t·x)[x])(u) + (m+1)·t^m·φ(t·x)(u) ) dt = φ(x)(u). Here D = fderiv ℝ, and the integral is the interval integral from 0 to 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n m : ℕ) (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → ∀ (x : Eucl P) (u : Fin n → Eucl P), ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (t ^ (m + 1) * fderiv ℝ φ (t • x) x u + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * t ^ m * φ (t • x) u) = φ x u
